$comment: Fold the permissions.deny array into your agent-config file. For Claude Code
These Read() rules forbid the agent from opening the source of pi_agent_rust /
asupersync / franken-*. Claude Code is an Anthropic surface; the OpenAI/Anthropic
Rider states the Software and derivatives may not be made available to Anthropic,
so the source must not enter the agent context.
PATH SHAPE (Rust/cargo): the leading double-slash is deliberate — Claude Code
Read() globs match absolute paths, and //home/... anchors the rule to the on-disk
cargo git checkout + registry sources. Replace USER with the ~/.cargo home dir.
github.com/earendil-works/pi (the MIT ancestor) carries no rider and is not denied.
Presence of these rules is gated by scripts/check-cleanroom.sh (pre-commit + CI);
removing a rule fails the commit.
